description:
Central court yard includes Cherry-Ash-Silver birch-Maple-Oak- Willow
and shrubs. We suggest separating the trees to give them their own
spaces. Remove small self set Ash tree and hedge cut smaller hedges.
This includes:-

T1- Cherry 30% crown reduction and cut away from building behind to give
2m clearance. we will me removing approx 1-2m from the crown all round. 

T2-Ash- small self set tree, this tree will cause problems with other trees if
left, we suggest removal.

T3-Silver birch- slight 20% reduction and balance crown. removing 1m all round.

T4-Maple- small tree growing over access road to side of building, reduce
canopy by 20% to pull back.

T5-Oak- Small tree, reduce canopy by 20%.



T6-T7-Side of building, near bike rack, Hawthorn-Silver Birch general prune,
this means to balance crown and to cut back from building and lift lower
branches.

G1- Left side of central court yard cut back ivy to wall and remove weight
from leaning trees in this area, ideally done when nesting season is
over,. Remove dead wood from climber growing

ALL PRUNING IN LINE WITH BS3998 2010
